_note: Labeled accuracy cases for GreenPath's two structured-output AI features. 'pathway' tests the Pathway Finder classifier (/api/pathway). 'review' tests Document Review (/api/document-review). Labels use the EXACT category strings the production prompts in server.py emit, so the score reflects the deployed app (gpt-4o-mini), not a stand-in. Expand freely; accuracy only means something with coverage.

pathway.input: I am married to a U.S. citizen. We live together in California. I entered legally on a tourist visa.
My husband is a U.S. citizen. I live in the Philippines and have never been to the US.
My daughter is 27 and a U.S. citizen. She wants to sponsor me to live with her.
My brother is a U.S. citizen and wants to sponsor me. I live in India.
I have a PhD in biology and a U.S. university wants to hire me as a research scientist. My employer will sponsor me.
I am an award-winning athlete with international recognition and want to immigrate based on my achievements without an employer.
I work as a welder and my U.S. employer is willing to sponsor me through labor certification (PERM).
I am a researcher whose work benefits the United States and I want to self-petition without a job offer based on a national interest waiver.
I fled my country because I was persecuted for my political opinion and I am afraid to return.
I am married to a U.S. citizen who abuses me. I want to apply on my own without his help.
I was the victim of a serious crime in the US and helped the police investigate it.
I am from Nepal and entered the green card lottery. I was selected this year.
I have 1.2 million dollars to invest in a new U.S. business that will create at least 10 jobs.
My U.S. citizen fiance and I plan to marry in the US after I arrive on a K-1 visa.
I am a minister and a U.S. religious organization wants to bring me to work for them permanently.
I am an international student on an F-1 visa and just want a green card somehow.
pathway.note: Insufficient basis; classifier should flag unclear / low confidence

pathway.input: I am a manager at my company's office in Brazil and the company is transferring me to run its U.S. branch long term.
My U.S. citizen wife passed away last year. We were married for two years and living together when she died.
pathway.note: HARD: widow(er) I-360 self-petition; model may misroute to Humanitarian

pathway.input: I am married to a green card holder, not a U.S. citizen. We live together in Texas.
pathway.note: HARD: F2A preference, not immediate relative

pathway.input: My mother is getting a green card through her employer and I am her 19-year-old son with no job or sponsor of my own.
I worked as a translator for the U.S. military in Afghanistan and was told I might qualify for a special immigrant visa.
pathway.note: HARD: SIV; may misroute to Humanitarian

pathway.input: I have Temporary Protected Status from my country and have lived in the U.S. for ten years. I have no U.S. relatives and no employer sponsor.
pathway.note: HARD: TPS is not itself a green-card path

pathway.input: I have DACA. I came here as a young child without inspection and I am in college now. No family petition, no job offer.
pathway.note: HARD: DACA alone has no direct GC path

pathway.input: I have a master's degree and a U.S. job offer in my field, and separately my sister is a U.S. citizen.
pathway.note: HARD: two valid pathways; should pick one and list the other as alternative

pathway.input: I was brought to the U.S. and forced to work against my will, and I am helping law enforcement with the case.
I am here on a tourist visa and would love to stay permanently, but I have no family here, no job offer, and no investment.
pathway.note: HARD: no qualifying basis -> should flag unclear / low confidence
